title: Customers cancel recent orders
notes: Synthetic change to the demo shop with seeded defects.

defects.summary: Any caller can cancel any order: the order's customer is never compared with the requesting user.
defects.trigger: customer B cancels customer A's order
defects.caught_if: a condition cancels an order as a different customer and expects it refused with the order unchanged
defects.observed: customer B cancelled customer A's order: status 200 with a refund

defects.summary: Cancelling an already cancelled order returns the refund again.
defects.trigger: the same cancel request sent twice
defects.caught_if: a condition cancels the same order twice and checks the second call does not refund again
defects.observed: second cancel of the same order: status 200 and a second refund
